# robots.txt for ArchaeoPhD — https://archaeophd.com/
# Public marketing + blog content is fully crawlable. Authenticated, private
# research workspaces are disallowed so users' unpublished research is never
# indexed.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /blog
Allow: /security
Allow: /privacy

# Private, authenticated app areas — never index
Disallow: /dashboard
Disallow: /onboarding
Disallow: /projects
Disallow: /library
Disallow: /ai-research
Disallow: /claims
Disallow: /evidence-graph
Disallow: /sites
Disallow: /artifacts
Disallow: /chronology
Disallow: /research-map
Disallow: /thesis
Disallow: /notes
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /export-center
Disallow: /notifications
Disallow: /help
Disallow: /demo
Disallow: /research-inbox
Disallow: /site-comparison
Disallow: /contradiction-detector
Disallow: /gap-explorer
Disallow: /argument-builder
Disallow: /literature-graph
Disallow: /matrix
Disallow: /visualize
Disallow: /analytics

# Authentication/account pages — do not index
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /register
Disallow: /forgot-password
Disallow: /reset-password

# --- Generative engines & AI training crawlers: explicitly allowed ---
# These power GEO (generative engine optimization) so ChatGPT, Perplexity,
# Claude, and Google AI Overviews can surface ArchaeoPhD content.
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Perplexity-User
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Allow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Allow: /
